scoring_justification: The paper reports no precise numeric thresholds for v or transmission_sum; the main claim is a qualitative transition at p≈0.2, which is robustly captured by relative orderings (structural trends). T1 recompute is infeasible because there is no fixed numeric gold to toleranced compare.

outputs.description: Correlation dimension of the average density of states for each disorder level. The trend v(p=0.1) > v(p=0.2) > v(p=0.4) indicates the formation of extended phonon bands at low disorder and a statistical fractal regime at higher disorder.

Total transmission sum over all sampled frequency bins for each disorder level. The transmission sum should be higher for p≤0.2 than for p>0.2, showing the transition from broad-band to low-frequency concentrated transport.

output_contract.notes: The agent may choose the frequency grid, lead natural frequency ω₀, and other numerical settings. The scored trend does not depend on absolute values. No absolute tolerances are required.

steps.description: Validate that the correlation dimension v satisfies v(0.1) > v(0.2) > v(0.4)
Validate transmission sum trends: T(0.1) > T(0.2) and T(0.4),T(0.6) < min(T(0.1), T(0.2))
